long_biography.plain_text:
Château Giscours became the centre of Eric Albada Jelgersma’s wine business after he took over its operating company in 1995. Determined to restore the Margaux estate’s quality, he persuaded young finance graduate Alexander van Beek to remain as director and surrounded him with leading vineyard and winemaking specialists.

Albada Jelgersma added neighbouring Château du Tertre and later Caiarossa on the Tuscan coast. At Caiarossa, he backed biodynamic and organic cultivation and sought a wine rooted in its Mediterranean landscape. The three estates became a second operating chapter after Dutch food retail, combining Bordeaux discipline with a separate Italian project built around biodiversity and parcel-by-parcel expression.
long_biography.html:
Château Giscours became the centre of Eric Albada Jelgersma’s wine business after he took over its operating company in 1995. Determined to restore the Margaux estate’s quality, he persuaded young finance graduate Alexander van Beek to remain as director and surrounded him with leading vineyard and winemaking specialists.

Albada Jelgersma added neighbouring Château du Tertre and later Caiarossa on the Tuscan coast. At Caiarossa, he backed biodynamic and organic cultivation and sought a wine rooted in its Mediterranean landscape. The three estates became a second operating chapter after Dutch food retail, combining Bordeaux discipline with a separate Italian project built around biodiversity and parcel-by-parcel expression.
